content.short: Jolocom is a privacy-first, self-sovereign Web3 identity protocol.
content.description: Jolocom is a privacy-first identity management protocol and infrastructure designed for self-sovereign identity flows. Its Smart Wallet provides a self-sovereign wallet capable of holding digital assets and, when necessary, securely sharing verified identity documents such as passports and driver's licenses online. Developers can integrate with the Jolocom SDK to build custom, self-sovereign dApps, while the platform's documentation supports fast, straightforward integration and adoption.
